question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

((18 + 2) - (6 × 2) / (2 - 4)) × 5 = 90?
solution: [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] Given: ((18 + 2) - (6 × 2) / (2 - 4)) × 5 = 90 According to the options, we need to interchange the signs to make the equation correct Option 1) + and - ((18 + 2) - (6 × 2) / (2 - 4)) × 5 = 90 ⇒ (__**(18 - 2)**__ + __**(6 × 2)**__ / __**(2 + 4)**__) × 5 = 90 ⇒ (16 + __**12 / 6**__) × 5 = 90 ⇒ __**(16 + 2)**__ × 5 = 90 ⇒ __**18 × 5**__ = 90 ⇒ 90 = 90
